about: The masters of the wiki's paintings (WebP, quality 90) and where each came from. Recraft painted the scenes (painted/<slug>.webp, as upscaled); tools/make-wiki-screens.py lays the app's own screens into their phones (screens.json says which, from the app's render-test goldens and demo-drive frames) and writes <slug>.webp, so every dial, number and readout on a phone is the app's (George, 24 Oct 2026: the painted dials were garbled). tools/make-wiki-art.py makes the served sizes from <slug>.webp. Licence: every image was made on VGraphics' Recraft Pro plan (a paid plan, so the images are ours to use commercially); the Worlds outpaint used Nano Banana 2.1 through the same Recraft Pro plan. Each entry's "tall" is its own picture for portrait screens (George, 24 Oct 2026: "Make tall version for all images. Crop sucks."): the master's tallCrop strip outpainted to 9:16 with Nano Banana 2.1 in Recraft (projects https://www.recraft.ai/project/2cdd5ac9-8349-431c-9f0a-041bd2a92feb and https://www.recraft.ai/project/ace58357-e13c-4c4b-bf56-438de61d7c58), Recraft Crisp-upscaled (26 Oct 2026, project https://www.recraft.ai/project/7bc4e391-4760-4cd0-96e3-e73a4fa06e52) and composed with the crisp strip by tools/make-wiki-tall.py.
